environment.runtime: Actual native main/preload/production renderer, macOS27.2 arm64/Electron43.7.0
environment.profile: Fresh isolated encrypted connection and dummy provider keys; shared keychain adapter disabled; hidden muted window
environment.network: Owned localhost music/source servers; X/text responses controlled; all remaining external origins blocked

decisions.Boris: Supported explicit empty array or omitted data with zero count, generic malformed/partial warnings and strict core fields.
decisions.Nadia: Supported source-specific validation; review identified supplied-count validation gap, corrected before final verification.
decisions.reservation: Optional metadata beyond supplied result_count not schema-validated; explicit arrays remain sufficient when count absent.
decisions.owner: Primary agent edited source branch and PRD; existing downstream state/UI reused.

verificationCorrection: First automatic native observation exited after10 seconds before the60-second tick; final fresh run awaited production interval and passed.

acceptance.S03: Review; no actual X access or live query relevance demonstrated.
acceptance.S07: Review; scoped manual draft/bucket warning feedback only.
acceptance.A08: Review; scoped manual and automatic X incomplete-source vs no-news behavior.

limits: No real X/text/voice request or paid provider work.
No actual generated audio, full screen-reader or regular-user usability exercise.
No overall acceptance percentage or completion claim.
